WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    SUM(orders.amount) AS "orders.amount_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "order_date",
    SUM(orders.amount) AS "orders.amount_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), _cm_orders__customers__score_max AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(customers.score) AS "score_max"
  FROM customers AS customers
), base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    _base_2."order_date",
    _base_2."orders.amount_sum",
    _cm_orders__customers__score_max."score_max" AS "customers.score_max"
  FROM _base_2
  CROSS JOIN _cm_orders__customers__score_max
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "order_date",
    "orders.amount_sum",
    "customers.score_max",
    CAST(SUM(CAST("orders.amount_sum" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF("customers.score_max", 0)) OVER (
      PARTITION BY CASE WHEN "order_date" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ORDER BY "order_date"
    ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS "cumsum"
  FROM base_2
), _cm_cumsum AS (
  SELECT
    "order_date",
    "cumsum"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "order_date",
      "orders.amount_sum",
      "customers.score_max",
      "cumsum"
    FROM step1
  ) AS _outer
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.order_date",
  CAST(CAST(_base."orders.amount_sum" AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(_cm_orders__customers__score_max."score_max", 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS "a"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_cumsum
  ON _base."orders.order_date" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cumsum."order_date"
CROSS JOIN _cm_orders__customers__score_max
WHERE
  _cm_cumsum."cumsum" > 9
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.order_date" ASC
